notes.views: Reach and affinity are different axes. Switch to Like rate: the biggest-reach posts are not the ones people loved most.

notes.comments: The most-commented post has a quarter of the top post's reach. A named mechanism makes people talk.

lessons.lesson: Talk about something real, with a name and a number.

lessons.lesson: Videos get you found. Carousels make fans stick.

lessons.lesson: Give people a way to reach you.
